label: producing a connected two-sentence message for a named reader
note: The A1 writing paper's second task -- 30 to 40 words to a named reader, 60 of that paper's 100 points -- rests on this rung. HI-W06-two-sentence-card and HI-W06-two-sentence-no-model deliver the connected two-sentence half with empty introduces lists and no named reader at all; they write a card, not a message to somebody. HI-C97-sandesh supplies the missing half as an atom -- the three stacked parts of a message, opening line naming the reader, sentences underneath, writer's name at the foot -- and HI-C97-sintesis-sandesh has the reader produce all three from a cue with no model. The probe pairs that shape with the address it opens with. The task's word count is still well above what the corpus asks a reader to produce here.
